reviews.author: Ying Phuket Customer
reviews.title: Always Smooth and Easy
reviews.body: Used this app for 2 years already and order almost every week. The service has always been smooth and reliable. The staff are very polite and friendly, and the service quality has been consistently good 😊

reviews.author: Phasakan
reviews.title: Late delivery and no one is answering the chat
reviews.body: Been ordering and shopping at villa for years. I ordered express delivering today and it’s been 2 hours, and i haven't got my items. The manager called to tell me that the order is late due to there is another express order… ( is this supposed to be my problem? ) i asked for help on the chat section on the app and there are no respond. My family is waiting for the food. This is such a bad experience. Will consider shopping else where.

reviews.author: aey_jc
reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.body: This app revolutionizes online shopping! It's incredibly user-friendly, offering a wide range of products. What's impressive is its lightning-fast delivery, always ensuring items are in stock. For stress-free shopping, this app is a must-have!

reviews.author: Nice Paul
reviews.title: App really needs work
reviews.body: After paying for the order, the goods still appear in the cart and the app shows ‘processing payment’ even after payment has gone through. I’ve brought this to the attention of their customer service maybe a dozen times but it never gets fixed. Extremely disappointing.
reviews.suggested_reply: We're sorry — a cart that still shows paid items and stays on 'processing payment' after you've paid (and after many CS reports) is unacceptable. Escalated to the payments/app team with your review attached.

reviews.title: App works great!
reviews.body: I get my groceries delivered right to my front door.  Staff are friendly and reply quickly within the app. No complaints here.

reviews.author: Eliseo.B
reviews.title: Great Store. Bad app
reviews.body: Product stock at VM is usually excellent. Also the delivery service, so far, is really good. But the app is old. Bad UX (not easy to use, bad filters, slow). But the most negative thing is after check out: it was my bank message to inform me about the payment successful

reviews.author: Farang working in Thailand
reviews.title: Absolutely horrible
reviews.body: Living in Bangkok and everyone told me to shop at Villa for western groceries. I thought, ok cool. Let’s try ordering delivery. Download the app. Doesn’t load. Open close open close. Finally opens. Select the location closest to me. Fill my cart. Asks to verify phone number. Put it in. Get messaged code. Doesn’t load. Try email. Doesn’t load. After multiple tries, finally works. Tries to check out, and then says wrong location even though this is the location closest to me. I switch the options available. Empties my cart! What a huge waste of time. I’ll try in person maybe in the future, but not any time soon.
reviews.suggested_reply: We're truly sorry for that first try: app wouldn't load, phone verify stalled, wrong-location errors, then the cart emptied when you changed store. Those are known bugs — your review is with the app team. In-app chat can help if you want to retry a first order.

reviews.author: greendaisy1
reviews.title: Can’t reset password
reviews.body: It keeps saying that my password is incorrect, so I clicked on Forget Password and entered my phone number and Continue. But nothing showed up, except when I clicked Continue three times, it said that I have exceeded the attempt limit. Useless and non-functional app. There is no customer service on LINE. Phone support also hangs up as soon as I say Hello. Very bad service overall.
reviews.suggested_reply: Sorry — wrong password loop, then Forget Password did nothing until you hit the attempt limit, plus no usable LINE/phone support. Password-reset and support gaps are both on us. Email ewallet@villamarket.com with your phone number if you need the account unlocked manually.

A number of items I can find in the store are nowhere to be found in the app. This is almost 2026 and the app’s search feature should be way more affective.

reviews.author: Rin G.
reviews.title: No option for hour delivery
reviews.body: I was so excited to use the app, but there is not an option for hour delivery on my app. Also, it looks like it may charge to deliver; I don’t think that’s right if you spend over a certain amount at the store because a lot of things there are expensive since they’re imported.. Also, my app says delivery between 2 to 5 days.. I don’t see set times. Only on pick up in the store.. App definitely needs some changes and updates to fix these bugs..

reviews.title: Refund process is bad -ended up no refund
reviews.body:
Some items were not available in the store, but they can be purchased through the app. Every time you need to check if all items received match the order, if not, or if some missing,  you have to contact the store for a refund “manually”. If you forget to do this, they don't care, they will take your money. 

I believe this is poor service and an incomplete process in advance.

reviews.author: VM Customer
reviews.title: Didn’t deliver and kept my money
reviews.body: I placed an on line order and the app took my money.  Then one day later the store called and said they were out of stock and would refund my money.  But 9 days later I have not received my refund and they keep giving me the run around.   Also why would they take my money if they were out of stock?     Very bad app and stock management.   Never use again.  I hope one day to see my money.  It’s my money not the stores.

They may have good food but they make it harder to find than is actually worth it. 
Just go in person or go to a better store.

Then they haves things ie  Clausons pickles or Pilsbury biscuits and all of a sudden for no reason … they won’t have it anymore. reviews.author: Sorsola
reviews.title: Needs improving
reviews.body:
Changed my card details months ago. I ask it to save my new card details every single time and it never does.

The search isn’t great.  Quick example: I want to buy Mainland Tasty Cheese. I type in “cheese” and it doesn’t appear in the results. I have to type in “Mainland” for it to show up.

Sloanes Cumberland sausage?

Won’t find it in the search if you look for “sausages”… only if you type in “Cumberland”.

The software testing needs improvement.
reviews.suggested_reply: Thanks for the concrete examples. Cards that never save after you update them, and search that misses 'Mainland Tasty Cheese' unless you type the brand, are both real bugs — logged with your test cases for the iOS/payments and search teams.

reviews.author: Hans Rume
reviews.body: Prices for the largest donkeys. All products are several times more expensive than in other stores. Avoid this scaaaaaam.
reviews.suggested_reply: Sorry the prices felt out of line. App prices should match the Villa store shelf — we don't add a hidden markup. If a specific item looked inflated, message us in-app with the product name and we'll check it.

reviews.author: Rickard Modig
reviews.body: app won't start unless you disable developer mode. also ridiculous to charge 140 for delivery when most other shops deliver practically for free. i could even schedule grab pickup myself for half that price.
reviews.suggested_reply: Sorry on both counts: the app shouldn't refuse phones with Developer Options on (Thai bank apps allow it — we're fixing that), and delivery fees should feel fair next to Grab/other options. Both notes are with the Android and ops teams.

reviews.author: Alexey Efimov
reviews.body: The app refuses to open when Developer Mode is enabled. This is an absurd restriction that provides no meaningful security benefit. As a developer, I need Developer Mode enabled, and I should not have to disable it just to use a grocery store app. Terrible design decision.
reviews.suggested_reply: You're right — blocking Developer Mode for a grocery app is a bad call and doesn't add real security. We've sent this to the Android team so shoppers (and developers) aren't forced to turn it off.

reviews.author: Thanva Tivawong

reviews.author: Hugh Musbekidding
reviews.body: Latest release takes forever to open. Stopped using at shopping till - faster to just give my phone number.
reviews.suggested_reply: Sorry the latest release takes forever to open — so long you gave up at the till. Slow/hung launch after update is a known issue we're chasing on Android. Thanks for spelling out the impact.

reviews.author: S De Silva
reviews.body: Not compatible with Android Developer Mode? There are no security issues tied to this mode, all Thai banks support it. If you're developer says otherwise, get another developer.
